test_make_tool_progress_cb: test the make_tool_progress_cb factory to emit ToolCallStart updates and track tool call IDs in FIFO queues
test_make_step_cb: test the make_step_cb factory to complete tracked tool calls and forward results to build_tool_complete
test_make_thinking_cb: test the make_thinking_cb factory to emit AgentThoughtChunk updates for non-empty thinking text
test_make_message_cb: test the make_message_cb factory to emit AgentMessageChunk updates for non-empty agent messages
test_duplicate_tool_calls_fifo_tracking: test that duplicate same-name tool calls are tracked independently using FIFO queues and completed in order
